item.title: [Message Center] MC1545691 Microsoft Purview: Retirement of select DSPM partner integrations
item.description:
Microsoft Purview will retire select DSPM partner integrations (Varonis, BigID, Cyera, OneTrust) for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. These integrations will no longer ingest or display data, but other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. No action is required, but review dependencies if using these integrations.

item.title: [New] Purview DSPM partner integrations for Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake and GCP retire on 7 December
item.description:
A data-security posture view that silently loses four non-Microsoft sources reports a smaller risk surface than the estate really has.

Purview · If any of the four integrations is connected, record which posture reports and alerts depend on it and move that coverage elsewhere before 7 December.
